---
name: Feature request
about: Suggest a new plugin, an improvement to an existing one, or a change to the marketplace
title: "[feat] "
labels: enhancement
assignees: Aboudjem
---

## What problem does this solve?

A clear description of the problem or gap you are experiencing.
Example: "I can't easily audit my Tailwind config for dark-mode contrast issues."

## Proposed solution

Describe the feature or change you would like to see.
Be as specific as you can: commands, MCP tools, output format, etc.

## Alternatives considered

Any other approaches you thought of and why you prefer the one above.

## Is this a new plugin submission?

If you are proposing a new plugin for the marketplace, please confirm it passes
the [10x bar](../../QUALITY-BAR.md) (or explain what needs to be built to reach it).

- [ ] Zero runtime dependencies (or clearly justified)
- [ ] One-command install, no config files or API keys required
- [ ] Real tests (not aspirational)
- [ ] Dual mode: works as a Claude Code plugin AND as a standalone MCP server (if applicable)
- [ ] Actively maintained (shipped this quarter)
- [ ] No telemetry, runs locally

## Additional context

Any other context, links, or screenshots.
